findings.message: مقدمة إنشائية كلاسيكية من نماذج اللغة.
findings.fix: احذف المقدمة وابدأ بالمشكلة مباشرة.

findings.message: نص رابط مبهم يضر قارئات الشاشة.
findings.fix: سمّ الوجهة التي يفتحها الرابط.

findings.message: زر عام بلا سياق.
findings.fix: حدد ما الذي سيعرفه القارئ عند الضغط.

findings.excerpt: هذا النص هو مثال لنص يمكن أن يستبدل. انضم إلى آلاف العملاء الراضين في مطعمنا.
findings.message: دليل اجتماعي مختلق أو قالبي.
findings.fix: اذكر رقمًا حقيقيًا موثقًا أو احذف العبارة.

findings.excerpt: هذا النص هو مثال لنص يمكن أن يستبدل. انضم إلى آلاف العملاء الراضين في مطعمنا.
findings.message: نص وهمي صريح في الواجهة العربية.
findings.fix: استبدله بمحتوى حقيقي أو بوسم [مطلوب من العميل].

findings.message: Emoji-prefixed `console.log` statement typical of LLM debugging output.
findings.fix: Use structured logger calls or remove debug logs before committing.

findings.message: Unfinished LLM stub comment (`// TODO: implement later`).
findings.fix: Implement the required behavior before shipping.

findings.message: Browser `alert('Thank you...')` used instead of inline form feedback.
findings.fix: Render an inline confirmation banner with a reference number.

findings.excerpt: const dummyData = [{ id: 1, name: 'Sarah Jenkins', company: 'TechFlow' }];
findings.message: Hardcoded `dummyData` / `mockData` array in application code.
findings.fix: Load real records from the data layer or name domain fixtures accurately in test files.

findings.message: Generic `handleClick` identifier that hides what action occurs.
findings.fix: Name handlers after the domain effect (`handleApproveInvoice`, `handleExportCsv`).

findings.message: Redundant comment restating syntax (`// Initialize state`).
findings.fix: Delete comments that merely narrate the next line of syntax.

findings.message: Source header comment attributing file to an AI generator.
findings.fix: Remove generator attribution comments.

findings.excerpt: const dummyData = [{ id: 1, name: 'Sarah Jenkins', company: 'TechFlow' }];
findings.message: Canonical LLM fictional testimonial persona names (`Sarah Jenkins`, `Michael Chen`, `Emily Rodriguez`).
findings.fix: Never invent testimonials. Use verified client quotes with permission or `[CLIENT INPUT NEEDED]`.

findings.excerpt: const dummyData = [{ id: 1, name: 'Sarah Jenkins', company: 'TechFlow' }];
findings.message: Synthetic LLM company names used in fake case studies or testimonials.
findings.fix: Use real client names with permission or remove the fictional company.

findings.message: Hardcoded Tailwind indigo-to-violet linear gradient.
findings.fix: Replace with a domain-grounded color token from tokens.css.

findings.message: Blanket transition: all causing layout and paint thrashing.
findings.fix: Transition only specific compositor or color properties (`opacity`, `transform`, `color`).

findings.message: Raw Tailwind indigo-500 hex literal in stylesheet.
findings.fix: Define a brand-specific semantic token in tokens.css.

findings.message: Raw Tailwind violet-500 hex literal in stylesheet.
findings.fix: Define a brand-specific semantic token in tokens.css.

findings.message: 100vh clips content behind mobile browser toolbars.
findings.fix: Use `min-height: 100dvh` with a `100vh` fallback.

findings.message: Removes keyboard focus ring without providing a visible replacement.
findings.fix: Use `:focus-visible` with a high-contrast 2px outline and offset.

findings.message: Dead placeholder anchor `href="#"`.
findings.fix: Point to a real route, a real section ID (`#pricing`), or use a `<button type="button">` for actions.

findings.message: Placeholder `example.com` link left in markup.
findings.fix: Replace with the real production URL or remove the link.

findings.message: Unedited framework starter `<title>`.
findings.fix: Write a specific page title (`Page Name — Brand Name`).

findings.message: Generator meta tag exposing an AI scaffolding tool.
findings.fix: Remove the `<meta name="generator">` tag.

findings.message: Arabic `<html lang="ar">` missing `dir="rtl"`.
findings.fix: Add `dir="rtl"` whenever `lang="ar"` is set.

findings.message: Dead placeholder link "#".
findings.fix: Point to a valid route, section anchor, or convert to <button type="button">.

findings.message: Placeholder domain in "https://example.com/menu".
findings.fix: Replace with the production URL or remove the link.

findings.message: HTML document is missing a <meta name="description"> of at least 20 characters.
findings.fix: Add a concrete 120-155 character meta description.

findings.message: Document exposes a <meta name="generator"> fingerprint.
findings.fix: Remove the generator meta tag.

findings.message: transition: all animates layout properties and causes frame drops.
findings.fix: Transition only transform, opacity, or color.

findings.message: Arabic HTML document is missing dir="rtl" on <html>.
findings.fix: Add dir="rtl" to <html lang="ar">.

findings.fix: Set letter-spacing: 0 on Arabic typography.
